definition: For a demanded target and a stance's own claim: Uniform demands both. Selective demands only the target although the two agree on a supplied feature k. Restricted demands only the target and the two differ on k. Each standing is relative to k, and neither Selective nor Restricted says k is the right feature or a defensible line.
note: Analyst-stated for #756. The results show the same stance can have both standings relative to different features.
